svg.aria-label: Star schema of the Henkel order-to-cash semantic layer: three facts in the middle, fact_order_line (13 rows), fact_billing_line (10) and fact_receivable (8), and seven dimensions around them: dim_date, dim_customer, dim_sales_organization, dim_material, dim_distribution_channel, dim_plant and dim_rejection_reason. Every column is listed with its PK and FK marks; each of the 20 foreign keys is one many-to-one line from the fact column to the key it references. fact_billing_line also points to fact_receivable and to fact_order_line, so every relationship is one-to-many.
svg.title: Henkel order-to-cash star schema

g.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key · crow's foot = many, bar = one · blue fact, green dimension
